content.short: Anzens is an EMURGO-backed Cardano platform for minting USDA and other real-world asset backed tokens.
content.description: Anzens is a Cardano-based real-world asset platform developed by EMURGO to let users access tokenized fiat-backed assets such as USDA. The project focuses on bringing regulated, asset-backed digital dollars and future currency or commodity products into the Cardano ecosystem. By connecting stable value assets with on-chain wallets and DeFi activity, Anzens is positioned as infrastructure for payments, savings, settlement, treasury operations, and liquidity use cases that need a dollar-denominated asset on Cardano.
content.meta: Anzens brings USDA and other asset-backed tokenization products to Cardano through EMURGO-backed RWA infrastructure. Explore Anzens on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
